verdict.rationale: Capacities documents a Full Export in Settings that can also run on an automated schedule. Exported properties become front matter values, collections are stored as CSV, and the docs describe exports as both human- and machine-readable, so a switcher can take the entire space out in open formats at any time. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that full exports work and round-trip into other tools, and explicit documentation of how links, block references and media/attachments are preserved in the export.
